# Irrigation Schedule Runbook

The watering interval is 3 days for every zone. Each watering runs 40 minutes, starting at 06:00.

Valves are opened in zone order (1 through 4) to keep manifold pressure stable, per the [Water System Overview](/knowledge-base/architecture-water-system-overview.md).
